source: plex.tv's answer to plexlab's own GET /api/v2/server/access_tokens (PMS headers, X-Plex-Client-Identifier = its machine id) once it was shared with a managed Home user, Movies only, allowSync=0, filterMovies contentRating=G,PG
note: SHARED-TOKEN is the accessToken plex.tv's /api/v2/resources gives the shared user for this server; the user's own account token is not listed and plexlab answered it 401. DEVICE-TOKEN-n are the owner's devices, names redacted. A share to a friend (not a Home member) has the same <token type="server"> shape: fun's Plex lists three that way.
